capabilities: Create classroom notes and run start/stop lecture listening sessions
Detect new clipboard screenshots during monitoring and add them to a classroom timeline
Transcribe Windows system audio in realtime via Qwen Realtime ASR
Organize transcripts and screenshots into structured notes with DeepSeek or Qwen AI
Recover automatically from audio helper and transcription connection drops
extras: README is in Chinese. API keys are stored unencrypted in data.json and the README warns not to share or commit them. The plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Audio is sent to the configured Qwen service, which may charge fees; recordings are not saved locally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture live classroom audio, screenshots, and transcripts during a lecture and organize them into structured study notes.
